| C1 | high | src/models/book.ts:29 | `>=` length check rejects a trimmed query of exactly 100 characters; spec allows 100 |

| C5 | high | src/views/books/search-results.ejs:10 | Author rendered with unescaped `<%-`, which allows stored XSS |
| T2 | high | tests/routes/search.test.ts:39 | Empty-query test checks only the count; missing and whitespace-only `q` are untested |
| C4 | medium | src/routes/books.ts:21 | HTMX endpoint returns no results for empty or missing `q` instead of all books |
| C6 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:195 | `tests/models/book-search.test.ts` is missing, and many required cases are untested |
| T3 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:51 | No test at exactly 100 or 101 characters |
| T4 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:51 | No test for `%` or `_` as literals or for parameterised SQL |
| T7 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:51 | No test for repeated `q` or for the `/api/books/search` alias |
| T8 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:59 | HTMX tests do not check "No books found.", the 400 response or escaping |
